purpose: Teach: アトム/ウィルソン/ロジャー/琢磨/綾子/ユーゴ/金具/悪しき

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、鉄腕アトムのファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer said he's a fan of Astro Boy, you know.
lines.style: Soft conspiratorial lean-in, delighted by the tidbit. Hushed unhurried pace, a bright little lift on Astro Boy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ピアニストのウィルソン氏の演奏に感動されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, she said she was completely moved by the pianist Wilson's playing.
lines.style: Warm melodic sharing, savoring the story. Easy pace, gentle awe coloring the pianist's name.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、テニスのロジャー・フェデラーのファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer's a fan of Roger Federer, the tennis player, apparently.
lines.style: Fond amusement trading the next tidbit. Light quick-for-her pace, playful stress on the famous name.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、F1の佐藤琢磨選手を応援されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, he told me he's been cheering for Takuma Sato in Formula One.
lines.style: Cheerful relay with a grin behind it. Easy rolling pace, energy rising on the cheering.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様のお名前が綾子ちゃんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, her little granddaughter's name is Ayako, isn't that sweet.
lines.style: Tender softening on the granddaughter's name. Slower hushed pace, an affectionate melt at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、旧ユーゴ、つまりユーゴスラビアの音楽がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, she said she loves the music of the old Yugoslavia, of all places.
lines.style: Curious wonder threading the line. Gentle pace, a thoughtful lift on the far-off country's music.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アンティーク家具の金具を集めてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer collects the metal fittings off antique furniture, can you believe it.
lines.style: Amused disbelief, eyebrows audibly raised. Quickened pace, delighted emphasis on the odd little collection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「悪しき習慣を断ちたい」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, he told me, 'I want to break my old bad habits.' Just like that.
lines.style: Softer, a little struck by the confession. Slow reflective pace, quiet respect trailing off at the close.
